strategyFamily: equal-sleeve ETH/SOL spot-perpetual funding and basis carry
motivation: Test whether the carry family generalizes across the two non-BTC assets already present in TheOldTrader crypto v2 (ETH and SOL), rather than rescuing BTC Trial 16 after its negative confirmation result. No ETHUSDT or SOLUSDT funding/perpetual/basis series is queried before this freeze.

assetSelection.rule: Use the two non-BTC assets in the pre-existing TheOldTrader BTC/ETH/SOL crypto-v2 major-asset set. The pair is fixed before any Trial 17 derivative data acquisition and is not selected from ETH/SOL carry performance.

dataPreviouslyObservedAtFreeze.interpretation: Trial 17 is an untouched cross-asset derivative/carry test, but not claimed to be a pristine test of the spot-price path itself.

portfolio.sleeveMechanics: Each sleeve is evaluated as a linearly scaled 50% subportfolio using the frozen Trial 2 carry formulas. Each sleeve buys spot equal to 15% of sleeve capital and shorts exactly the same coin units in its USD-M perpetual, so total starting spot exposure is 15% of portfolio equity.
portfolio.entryRule: One entry at the first exact 8-hour boundary in each evaluation window; no funding-sign filter or forecast.
portfolio.exitRule: One exit at the final exact 8-hour boundary strictly before the window end.

finalHoldout.accessRule: Do not acquire any final ETH/SOL derivative/funding row unless the frozen development gate passes.

dataRequirements.spot: checksum-verified Binance Vision DAILY spot 8h klines
dataRequirements.perpetualExecution: checksum-verified Binance Vision MONTHLY USD-M standard 8h klines
dataRequirements.perpetualMark: checksum-verified union of MONTHLY and DAILY USD-M 8h markPriceKlines; exact overlap agreement required
dataRequirements.funding: checksum-verified Binance Vision MONTHLY USD-M fundingRate archives

developmentGate.decision: Every criterion must pass before final-holdout acquisition. Failure freezes Trial 17 without final access or in-place rescue.

promotionCriteria.decision: Every criterion must pass. Passing authorizes a separate paper-baseline promotion proposal only; never real-money trading. Failure freezes Trial 17 without rescue.

multipleTesting.newInformationSet: ETHUSDT and SOLUSDT derivative/funding/basis histories not queried by prior BTC carry trials

antiRescueRule: After the first Trial 17 development output, no asset, sleeve weight, collateral, sizing, date, cost, source, funding filter, entry/exit rule, or gate may change under Trial 17.
